claim: Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) is not supported: VPC endpoints do not generate the ICMP Destination Unreachable, Fragmentation needed and Don't Fragment was Set message (Type 3, Code 4).

evidence.quote: Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) is not supported. VPC endpoints do not generate the following ICMP message: `Destination Unreachable: Fragmentation needed and Don't Fragment was Set` (Type 3, Code 4).
